scope: CPU UI plus tessellation; all egui UI passes included. Cold and rebuild stages use the full display range. The later zoom sequence directly sets central 60%, 30%, 10%, 1%, then full ranges, measuring one operation frame and three followups per range without clearing caches or hints. It measures redraw costs, not OS zoom event delivery. Prepared row/channel counts verify trace preparation, not visibility inside the clipped viewport. The default 1280x900 geometry matches the prior statistics benchmark; three rows may extend below the clipped viewport. Viewport height is configurable. Visible/paint times are subsets of UI; tile/edge construction times are subsets of visible preparation. Edge build time counts only completed retained caches; edge scan time includes all attempts, including aborted dense scans, and overlaps edge build time. Raw loading and synchronous reference statistics occur before rendering and are excluded. First cold frame is one sample after loading; cache rebuild trials retain the same raw data in one process and are not independent process starts. No statistics worker runs. Excludes OS event delivery, GPU and presentation. RSS is sampled outside frame timers at phase boundaries, not continuous peak RSS.
